what_i_changed: Updated pipeline collection handling so an incomplete collection whose stop reason indicates a rate limit sets PipelineResult.rate_limited=True, while retaining the existing incomplete status and recorded reason.
how_it_takes_the_required_approach: The collection-truncation branch now detects rate-limit wording (including hyphenated forms) from CollectResult.stopped_because and merges it into the run-level rate_limited flag. No tests were changed.
